body: Build me a todo app with a simple interface using a client side db. It should allow me to create a task, mark it done, delete it. Create it in todo folder.

comments.body:
Picking this up 👀

**Ask:** a todo app with a simple interface and a client-side database: create a task, mark it done, delete it, in a `todo` folder.

**Done in** https://github.com/karachiwaladev/contour-jonas-oct-2026-eng-muhammad-anas/commit/6cc0e7d, with the UI later redesigned in bdda1ec: [`todo/index.html`](https://github.com/karachiwaladev/contour-jonas-oct-2026-eng-muhammad-anas/blob/main/todo/index.html). To run it, open `todo/index.html` in a browser. There's no build step and nothing to install.

**Verification** (headless Microsoft Edge driven over the DevTools protocol, 9/9 passed)
- [x] Lives in the `todo/` folder, with its own `todo/CLAUDE.md`
- [x] Client-side database: IndexedDB (`todo-app` / `tasks`)
- [x] Create a task
- [x] Mark a task done, and the counter updates (`2 of 3 left`)
- [x] Delete a task
- [x] Tasks are still there after a page reload
- [x] All / Active / Done filters
- [x] Empty state shown when there are no tasks
- [x] No console errors

![Todo app](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/karachiwaladev/contour-jonas-oct-2026-eng-muhammad-anas/main/todo/screenshots/redesign-list.png)
